# Social preview

The repository social preview image is **`assets/og-image.png`** (1200×630) — the same brand card
used by the site. To set it:

1. Go to **Settings** → **Social preview** in the repository.
2. Upload `assets/og-image.png`.
3. Save.

The site's own OpenGraph and Twitter cards are generated at build time from the brand assets in
`frontend/public/icons/` (see `frontend/README.md`).
